title: Leading the band at Milneburg; Cripple Voynell and Edward Johnson
summary: He led the band at a lakefront place at Milneburg with Cripple Voynell and Edward Johnson; the interviewer hopes to find them.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was leader of the band? Out there?

Yes. Well, I was leading the band out there because I had, who I was there playing with me was Cripple Voynell and Cripple Voynell and Edward Johnson across the street. He's old now. I don't think he played anymore. What's his name?
No, Edward Johnson. He played saxophone. We had in the Cripple Voynell. Do you know him? Cripple Voynell?
He used to hop around the drum and run with him and make a run. He's had a Cripple Foot. He went to, last time I heard from him, he was in North, you know, Alexander.
Mr. Jones is still living then. Yeah, he's over there. We'll have to try to talk to him sometime.
He's going to play no more, but.
We'd still like to talk to him, you know, because he'd remember, could tell us about
his life. Johnson. Yeah, he can tell you about it. Johnson.
I used to play with him too, you know.
Well, let's say Jones. After Johnson, I mean. Eddie Johnson. Oh, yes, I've heard of him.
You know him? Eddie Johnson. I've heard of him, yes.
You know Santiago? Yes. Well, that's his brother-in-law. That's his brother-in-law. I was mixed up.
You were talking about Jones was the bass player.
